DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_report_id as "incidentReportId", incident_param_id as "incidentParamId", value as "value", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM "rt".ims_incident_param_values;
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ims_incident_param_values (incident_report_id, incident_param_id, value, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:incidentReportId, :incidentParamId, :value, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.ims_incident_param_values SET value = :value, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_param_id = :incidentParamId AND incident_report_id = :incidentReportId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.ims_incident_param_values WHERE incident_param_id = :incidentParamId AND incident_report_id = :incidentReportId
